reason: This plugin is primarily a user-interface enhancement for DeepSeek Harness, adding a floating visual indicator in the web client to show whether pricing is in peak or off-peak hours by Beijing time, with optional detail view and draggable placement; its structure and described behavior align most closely with layout/overlay UI tooling.

summaries.zh: 本插件在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面中显示一个可拖动的峰谷计费角标，实时提示当前是高峰还是优惠时段，并可展开查看时间与参考计费信息。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a draggable badge in the DeepSeek Harness web UI that shows in real time whether pricing is currently in peak or off-peak time and can open a small details view.

capabilities: Web UI overlay badge injection in DeepSeek Harness
Time-based peak/off-peak status display using Beijing time logic
Persistent badge position via browser storage

reasons.code: README describes a floating peak/off-peak pricing badge that updates automatically and shows current status in the DeepSeek Harness web GUI.
Repository metadata declares a web client plugin with DSH client runtime/layout injection and shell overlay usage, confirming its UI-extension purpose.
README states the badge is draggable and that its position is saved in localStorage for persistence across refreshes.
